author: NASS
description:
I colorized, restored, and created a sound design for this fascinating footage of Toronto, Canada, in the 1935, capturing the city’s streets, traffic, and everyday life. The film features scenes around Broadview and Danforth, Sunnyside, Danforth Division, the Canadian National Exhibition entrances, the Bay Street terminal, ferry service, and North Toronto terminal, offering a remarkable glimpse into Toronto nearly a century ago.

🛠️ Video Restoration Process:
✔ FPS boosted to 60 frames per second
✔ Image resolution enhanced up to 4K quality
✔ Improved video sharpness and brightness with my own AviSynth scripts
✔ Colorized only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
✔ Sound design created for immersive atmosphere
✔ Full restoration: stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring made with my own AviSynth and VapourSynth scripts

Please, be aware that colorization colors are not real and fake, colorization was made only for the ambiance and do not represent real historical data.
title: Toronto, Canada 1935 in color [60fps, Remastered] w/sound design added
